# Lucide icon provenance

Huterm embeds selected SVG icons from the `lucide-static` npm package at the
exact version `package.json` pins, which each icon's license header also
records. The package is licensed under ISC. Some selected icons are derived
from Feather Icons and are also covered by the MIT notice included in the
package's license file.

Source package: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/lucide-static>

The complete upstream copyright and license text is in `LICENSE` alongside this
file and accompanies the packaged application.
